text:
Maya (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands on partner GTM + pipeline hygiene. capturing the Qs that came up and next steps.
Aria (GTM): partners asked for a single-line eligibility rule for co-sell credits we can quote on calls. can we finalize?
Noor (RevOps): rough single-line: "Approved partners receive co-sell credits on first-year ACV for deals with a partner_source tag and verified partner-introduced demo." final subject to Legal.
Ana (Legal): OK to use as plain-language guidance; will add formal language for the playbook. expect redlines tomorrow.
Liam (Sales): small ops ask: please standardize the partner handoff in CRM. reps should not have to rewrite context every time.
Noor (RevOps): adding a minimal handoff template with required fields: partner name, intro email, buyer problem statement, expected timeline, co-demo flag. will block stage advance if missing.
Zoe (Marketing): partners want a short demo kit (1-page + 5-step script). Marketing will produce a co-branded kit and a one-slide ROI that reps can attach. ETA Wed.
Maya (CEO): what about demo environment? partners need low-friction access without exposing prod.
DevBot: notice: partner-demo-tenant v1 created at 1875000100. staging keys will rotate daily.
Aria (GTM): also asked about SLA for partner lead response. leadership proposed 8 business hours triage, AE outreach within 24 for strategic partners.
Noor (RevOps): will implement CRM alerts and a Slack escalation if partner leads sit >12 hours unassigned.
Liam (Sales): for forecasting, how do we treat partner-originated trials in commit? reps asked if these should count.
Noor (RevOps): rule: trials enter pipeline as best-case; only move into commit after POC acceptance or signed LOI. will publish forecast rubric.
Maya (CEO): action items summarized: 1) finalize single-line credit guidance (Ana) 2) CRM handoff template + validation (Noor) 3) demo kit + ROI slide (Zoe) 4) partner-demo tenant + keys (Eng/Product via DevBot) 5) SLA doc and escalation rules (Aria/RevOps). please add any follow-ups here.
Liam (Sales): ack, will run a 20m pilot with 3 reps next Wed to test handoff + kit.
Aria (GTM): scheduling poll in #all-hands, will ping partners.
DevBot: all-hands follow-up doc created at 1875000400 and linked in #product-docs. :memo:
